description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105) capped at 19999, removes KO [Raise: 100%] capped at 19999, grants [Haste], [High Quick Cast 2], grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Soother Mode I (Deuce)] and [White Magic Healing Resonance Boost +5%] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Soother Mode I (Deuce)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for White Magic and Bard abilities after using 1/2/3+ White Magic or Bard abilities, increases healing done by White Magic and Bard abilities by 10%/15%/20% after using 1/2/3+ White Magic or Bard abilities, grants [Stoneskin: 10%]/[Stoneskin: 15%]/[Stoneskin: 20%]/[Stoneskin: 25%]/[Stoneskin: 30%] after using White Magic or Bard abilities at rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Soother Mode II (Deuce)], removes [Dual Awoken Soother Mode I (Deuce)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Soother Mode II (Deuce)
description.text: Instant cast speed for White Magic or Bard abilities, casts Soothing Whistle after using White Magic or Bard abilities

description.name: Soothing Whistle
description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [Last Stand] and [Quick Cast 1]

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle

description.name: White Magic Healing Resonance Boost +5%
description.text: White Magic abilities restore 5% more HP
